title: metathelypteris flaccida
intro: Metathelypteris flaccida, commonly known as the Limestone Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. It is a deciduous, perennial plant native to Southeast Asia, prized for its potential health benefits and unique characteristics. Metathelypteris flaccida has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, with its therapeutic actions attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
